findings.issue: Shared f.publish invalidation/cancellation does not clear controls-only passed flag; controls account clears it only on budget failure. After completed cases a late non-budget stable failure can leave invalidated + passedTrue and main exit0.
findings.required_fix: Clear passed for any noncompleted final status and require status completed AND passed for exit0. Lead should inject a pure publisher stable failure before Native launch.

findings.issue: Completed cases have no retained inventory witness until after all cases. Mutation of an earlier candidate/report/component receipt between case completion and the final snapshot is adopted as fresh completed material without rechecking stored entry hashes.
findings.required_fix: Freeze each completed Job inventory immediately and check in stable across subsequent cases; optionally recheck final per-entry authoritative evidence.

findings.issue: physical-short passes for any blocking finding, so an unrelated invalid outline/pad/track error can satisfy the falsifier without demonstrating the deliberate different-net contact was reported.
findings.required_fix: Bind an actual short/contact finding to the intended SIGNAL_A/SIGNAL_B items. Freeze expected native finding semantics after inspecting the pinned raw report; do not guess a unique native type.
